section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
title: INSPECTION AND REPAIR OF STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to remove bearing from upper bracket of steering column

content.text: 1. IF NECESSARY, REPLACE BEARING IN UPPER BRACKET

items: (a) Using SST and a hammer, remove the bearing.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool and hammer being used to install bearing into upper bracket

items: (b) Pack MP grease into the bearing.
(c) Using SST and a hammer, drive the bearing into the bracket.
(a) Using SST and a press, remove the lower bearing from the main shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool and press being used to remove lower bearing from main shaft

items: (b) Pack MP grease into the bearing.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool and press being used to install lower bearing onto main shaft

items: (c) Using SST and a press, assemble the lower bearing and main shaft.
